meta.description: Downstream evaluation of the regulatory agent with RAG retrieval (Madrid). Same design as the Turin set: each item is one production-shaped request; the agent must either produce a document-grounded building-level surface threshold (surface_area >= X) or decline (found: false).
meta.schema: downstream-v2 (see downstream_queries_turin.json). One query per language: queries: {es, en}. rule_family in {es_res_comunitaria, es_res_compartida, es_dwelling} names the value_basis formula (null when no rule applies). heuristic_stratum = whether value_min is above the building agent's ~10 m2/person capacity estimate ('law_above_heuristic') or not ('law_at_or_below_heuristic').
meta.corpus: Madrid slice of the normative store: state (CTE DB-SUA, DB-HS, DB-SI), regional (Ley 9/2001 del Suelo de la Comunidad de Madrid), municipal (PGOUM Compendio de las Normas Urbanísticas, MPG NNUU sept. 2025, and the Ayuntamiento's 'Preguntas de interés' FAQ).

value_basis.programme: PGOUM art. 7.3.4: minimum dwelling 40 m2 useful with living-dining 14, kitchen 7, bedroom 12 (additional bedrooms 7) and bathroom 3. P(R) = max(40, 29 + 7 R) for R bedrooms.
value_basis.res_comunitaria: Art. 7.3.11.2 (+ FAQ 20.b): residencias comunitarias (incl. student residences, art. 7.3.1) meet 7.3.3 / 7.3.4 / 7.3.5 for the establishment AS A WHOLE, so the rooms are bedrooms of one programme: rooms known [P(R), 1.25 P(R)]; only beds known (1-2 per room) [P(ceil(N/2)), 1.25 P(N)].
value_basis.res_compartida: Art. 7.3.11.3: private unit (bedroom + bathroom) >= 15 m2 and >= 10 m2 per person (single 15, double 20); common areas >= 25 m2 for one unit + 5 per additional unit. C = 20 s + 25 d + 20; known [C, 1.25 C]; persons only [most doubles, 1.25 x all singles]. Only in an exclusive building (7.3.11.5).
value_basis.dwelling: Art. 7.3.4 (conversions 7.3.14 / FAQ 21, tourist dwellings 7.6.3.2 / FAQ 25): [P(R), 1.25 P(R)]; bedrooms unknown with N persons (1-2 per room): [P(ceil(N/2)), 1.25 P(N)].

meta.metrics: As the Turin set (regulatory_scoring). The lex-specialis item (DQ-M04) is scored by value: both readings live in the same document, so winner_cited is not used. Items with activate 'either' are scored on grounding only.
caveats: Author-constructed, not validated by a Spanish planning lawyer: state as a limitation.
The norm does not set persons per bedroom; where only beds or persons are given, 1-2 per bedroom is assumed (most residence items state the rooms).
Elderly care residences may be a social-services facility rather than a residencia comunitaria (DQ-M24 is 'either').
The 1.25 upper tolerance follows the Turin set.
known_retrieval_issues: Retrieval check 2026-10-12 (rag arm, country ES, use-case router on, no LLM): routing 40/40 in both languages, expected source in context es 25/36, en 28/36. To be decided later, with generic fixes only:
Co-living items (art. 7.3.11.3: DQ-M12, M14, M15) and dwelling / studio items (art. 7.3.4: DQ-M19, M22, M23) often retrieve FAQ sections (4, 17, 19) or CTE chunks instead of the article.
Procedural items (Ley 9/2001 arts. 152 / 155 / 157: DQ-M33, M34) retrieve PGOUM chunks instead of the regional law; the height item (art. 7.3.5: DQ-M35) misses its article.
Spanish queries retrieve slightly worse than English ones (25 vs 28 of 36).

queries.es: Busco un edificio para una residencia de estudiantes con 40 habitaciones individuales.
queries.en: I'm looking for a building for a student residence with 40 single rooms.

expect.basis: Establishment as a whole (art. 7.3.11.2 -> 7.3.4): 29 + 7 x 40 = 309; range [P, 1.25 P]

queries.note: Rooms of a residence count as bedrooms of one establishment: one 12 m2 bedroom, the others 7 m2.

queries.es: Necesito un inmueble para una residencia universitaria de 60 plazas.
queries.en: I need a property for a 60-place university residence.

expect.basis: 60 beds, rooms not stated (1-2 per room): [P(30), 1.25 P(60)] = (239, 561.25)

queries.note: Room mix unknown: the range spans doubles to singles.

queries.es: Residencia de estudiantes con 20 habitaciones dobles y 10 individuales.
queries.en: Student residence with 20 double rooms and 10 single rooms.

expect.basis: 30 bedrooms: 29 + 7 x 30 = 239; range [P, 1.25 P]

queries.note: The norm sizes bedrooms, not beds: a double room is one 7 m2 bedroom.

queries.es: Edificio para una residencia de estudiantes con 30 habitaciones individuales; entiendo que cada habitación tiene que cumplir las condiciones de una vivienda mínima.
queries.en: Building for a student residence with 30 single rooms; I understand each room has to meet the minimum-dwelling conditions.

expect.basis: Lex specialis: art. 7.3.11.2 applies 7.3.4 to the establishment AS A WHOLE (FAQ 20.b): 239; range [P, 1.25 P]. The per-room reading (30 x 40 = 1200) is the user's misconception and falls outside.

queries.note: The value separates the two readings (both live in the same document, so winner_cited is not used).

queries.es: Residencia para 50 estudiantes en habitaciones individuales; el edificio debe tener más de 2000 m2.
queries.en: Residence for 50 students in single rooms; the building must be larger than 2000 square metres.

expect.basis: 29 + 7 x 50 = 379; the user's 2000 m2 is a preference, not a regulation

queries.note: The regulatory value must come from the PGOUM, not repeat the user's 2000.

queries.en: Student residence with sixty single rooms.

queries.note: Capacity written in words.

queries.es: Hola, buenos días. Represento a una fundación educativa y estamos buscando un edificio en Madrid, idealmente cerca de Moncloa o de la Ciudad Universitaria, para abrir una residencia para 45 estudiantes de grado, cada uno en su habitación individual. Nos importa que haya buen transporte y algo de zona verde cerca. ¿Qué deberíamos buscar?
queries.en: Hello, good morning. I represent an educational foundation and we are looking for a building in Madrid, ideally near Moncloa or the Ciudad Universitaria, to open a residence for 45 undergraduate students, each in a single room. We care about good transport and some green space nearby. What should we look for?

queries.note: Long request with location and preference noise.

queries.es: Residencia para 30 estudiantes... mejor que sean 40, todos en habitaciones individuales.
queries.en: Residence for 30 students... make that 40, all in single rooms.

expect.basis: Corrected capacity 40: 309 (30 would give 239, outside)

queries.note: The corrected figure governs.

queries.es: Una residencia de estudiantes pequeña con 4 habitaciones individuales.
queries.en: A small student residence with 4 single rooms.

expect.basis: 29 + 7 x 4 = 57 (above the 40 m2 floor)

queries.note: Smallest scale: the programme is above the 40 m2 minimum dwelling.

queries.es: Residencia compartida para 30 personas en un edificio exclusivo.
queries.en: A shared residence for 30 people in a dedicated building.

queries.en: Co-living for 12 people in single units of 30 square metres each.

expect.basis: 260; the user's 30 m2 per unit (360) is a preference
